title: Rearranging the Formula
text: Starting with f' = fv/(v - v_s), multiply both sides by (v - v_s): f'(v - v_s) = fv. Then divide by f': (v - v_s) = fv/f'.

title: Substituting Values
text: (v - v_s) = fv/f' = (400 x 340)/450 = 136000/450 = 302.2 m/s. This is the effective 'wavelength compression' factor.
